gloss: to cooperate; to collaborate; to work together

definitions.gloss: to cooperate; to collaborate; to work together
definitions.explanation: To join efforts with others to accomplish a shared goal or to assist someone in their endeavor.

examples.japanese: ご{協力|きょうりょく}をお{願|ねが}いします。
{全員|ぜんいん}が{協力|きょうりょく}して{問題|もんだい}を{解決|かいけつ}した。
examples.english: Everyone cooperated to solve the problem.

examples.japanese: {両国|りょうこく}は{環境|かんきょう}{問題|もんだい}で{協力|きょうりょく}することに{合意|ごうい}した。
examples.english: The two countries agreed to cooperate on environmental issues.

examples.japanese: {地域|ちいき}の{人|ひと}たちが{協力|きょうりょく}して{祭|まつ}りを{運営|うんえい}している。
examples.english: The local people work together to run the festival.

notes:
An extremely common word in both formal and everyday contexts. The polite request ご{協力|きょうりょく}お{願|ねが}いします is ubiquitous in public announcements, signs, and official communications. The pattern is AがBに{協力|きょうりょく}する (A cooperates with B) or AとBが{協力|きょうりょく}する (A and B cooperate).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ご{協力|きょうりょく}ください: please cooperate (polite request)
- {国際|こくさい}{協力|きょうりょく}: international cooperation
- {協力|きょうりょく}{関係|かんけい}: cooperative relationship
- {協力|きょうりょく}{体制|たいせい}: cooperative framework
- {協力|きょうりょく}を{得|え}る: to gain someone's cooperation

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {手伝|てつだ}う: to help — more casual and personal; implies lending a hand
- {連携|れんけい}する: to coordinate, to link up — emphasizes organized, systematic collaboration
- {提携|ていけい}する: to form a partnership — formal; implies an official business alliance
